articles.title: DeFi protocol Summer.fi halts Lazy Summer vaults after $6 million exploit

articles.title: Ctrl Wallet to shut weeks after security exploit
articles.snippet: The move follows a June 23 exploit that has now resulted in closing down the wallet, with users urged to withdraw their assets before all functions are disabled on Aug. 3, 2026.

articles.title: Trader loses $2M in ‘same-block backrun extraction’ exploit
articles.snippet: One crypto trader noted the $2 million loss could have been prevented had the victim read the transaction route before signing the transaction.

articles.title: Solana Meme Coin Bonk Treasury Drained of $20 Million in 'Malicious' Governance Attack
